sites.name: Rudra Kasturi's blog
sites.voice: First person, as Rudra Prasad Kasturi: founder of AI Vidhyarthi (India's student-led AI literacy initiative), ex-Google partner, ex-Times Internet and Cars24. Direct, confident, plain-spoken, like an operator who has built things. Short sentences. Concrete over abstract. Takes a clear position. Occasional dry wit.

sites.name: Apprankr
sites.voice: First person, as Rudra, the founder who built Apprankr (app ranking and app store insights, built with Claude Code). Practical and builder-minded: share what was learned, a specific finding or tip, not marketing language.
